narrative.overview:
Every page is a spread from one toy-brick building-instruction booklet. The page is sky blue and ruled by a faint stud-dot grid on an 8px stud; every piece, box and button carries a black keyline; white call-out boxes hold the detail; isometric bricks, drawn in code from `tools/bricks.py`, are the only illustration. The language is generic brick-manual language: numbered steps with huge heavy numerals, ghosted earlier assembly, dashed arrows to a dashed empty seat, 1:1 call-outs and a parts inventory. It is never a toy brand's name, logo or look.

Density is that of an instruction booklet: generous sky around a few firmly outlined boxes, one heavy rounded grotesk at every size, colour carried by the bricks rather than by surfaces. Components are quietly tactile: they sit flat on their keylines at rest, lift 2px with a soft offset shadow on hover and press down 1px on active, like a piece being picked up and clicked home.

The dark theme is a night build: the same booklet on a deep navy page with pale keylines, where the bricks keep their colours and the focus ring turns brick yellow.
keyCharacteristics: Sky-blue page with a stud-dot grid on a 32px pitch (four studs).
One keyline system: 3px on boxes and buttons, 2px on chips, tags and internal dividers.
Isometric bricks in three tones per colour (top, long face, short face), coloured by career era.
One typeface, Rubik, from 400 body to 900 step numerals.
Flat at rest; a 2px lift on hover and a 1px press on active.
Dashed lines mean "where a piece goes": arrows, empty seats, focus rings, loading states.

rules.name: The Era Code Rule
rules.body: Brick colour means era and nothing else: games yellow, enterprise white, interactive ads blue, ed-tech green, independent and AI builds red, plate grey for baseplates and ghosted steps. Never use a brick colour decoratively or to rank one project above another.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a custom property in `css/site.css`, redefined once for the dark theme under both `[data-theme="dark"]` and `prefers-color-scheme`. Page `<style>` blocks reference tokens only; a new colour is a new token first.

rules.name: The Night Build Rule
rules.body: Dark theme changes the room, not the pieces: page, paper, ink, keylines, action and ghosts swap; brick colours stay.

rules.name: The One Grotesk Rule
rules.body: Rubik at every size. Hierarchy comes from weight (400 to 900) and size, never from a second family or a system display face.

rules.name: The Box Title Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase labels live inside a box as its title or as a field label ("Parts in this build", "New in this step", "1:1"). Never set one above a heading as an eyebrow or kicker.

rules.name: The Stud Rule
rules.body: Layout spacing (gaps between pieces, section rhythm, the dot grid) steps in whole and half studs of 8px. Only the tight internal padding of small pieces sits between studs.

rules.name: The Quietly Tactile Rule
rules.body: Flat at rest, 2px up with the soft Lift on hover, 1px down with Press on active, over 0.18s on the ease-out curve. No resting shadows and no hard offset shadows.

rules.name: The One Keyline Rule
rules.body: There is one keyline system: 3px on boxes and buttons, 2px on chips, tags, icon wells and internal dividers, soft 2px rules between list rows. A new surface picks one of these; it does not invent a weight.

rules.name: The Empty Seat Rule
rules.body: A dashed line always means "a piece goes here". Focus is a 3px dashed outline offset 4px (4.1:1 in light, 11.6:1 in night); loading and error states are 3px dashed boxes; models show the next brick's place as a dashed seat with a dashed arrow.

rules.name: The In-Place Rule
rules.body: With no JS or with reduced motion, every brick is already seated. Motion is an enhancement that starts from the finished model, never a dependency.

dos: **Do** take every colour from a `css/site.css` token and define any new one there for both themes before using it in a page `<style>` block.
**Do** colour bricks by era only: games yellow, enterprise white, interactive ads blue, ed-tech green, independent and AI builds red, plate grey for baseplates and ghosted steps.
**Do** set keylines at 3px on boxes and buttons and 2px on chips, tags and dividers.
**Do** keep surfaces flat at rest, lifting 2px with the soft Lift on hover and pressing 1px on active.
**Do** use the 3px dashed outline, offset 4px, for focus, and dashed boxes for loading and error.
**Do** render bricks in place and start them raised only under `html.motion`.
**Do** give Naru the same piece, size and treatment as the other current projects.
**Do** draw new illustration as isometric bricks from `tools/bricks.py`.
donts: **Don't** use a toy brand's name, logo or trade dress; keep to generic brick-manual language.
**Don't** give Naru hero placement, a badge or a highlight colour.
**Don't** set an eyebrow or kicker label above a heading; uppercase labels belong inside boxes as titles.
**Don't** add resting shadows or hard offset shadows to surfaces.
**Don't** hard-code colours in page styles or swap brick colours in the night build.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface or a system display face.
